earnings.title: To Our Shareholders and the Broader Investment Community,
highlights: Revenues increased 7% for the third quarter to $25.2 billion from $23.7 billion in Q3 fiscal 2025.
Total segment operating income increased 21% to $5.6 billion from $4.6 billion in Q3 fiscal 2025.
Diluted earnings per share (EPS) decreased to $1.51 from $2.92 in Q3 fiscal 2025.
Adjusted EPS (1) increased to $2.06 from $1.61 in Q3 fiscal 2025.
outlook: We continue to expect fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS growth of approximately 12%, excluding the impact of the 53 rd week.
We continue to expect fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS growth of approximately 16%, including the impact of the 53 rd week.
We expect Q4 total segment operating income of approximately $4.9 billion, including the impact of the 53 rd week.
Our Sports segment operating income decline of 17% versus the prior-year quarter was modestly steeper than our prior guidance of approximately 14%.

items.heading: Declines in U.S., global and regional economic conditions adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

items.heading: Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates impact our results of operations, including our revenues and costs.

items.heading: Changes in technology, in consumer consumption patterns and in how entertainment products and services are created affect demand for, the revenue we can generate from and the cost of producing or distributing our entertainment offerings and our results of operations.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESSES AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: We face risks relating to misalignment with public and consumer tastes and preferences for entertainment, travel and consumer products, which impacts demand for our entertainment offerings and products and services and our results of operations.

A variety of uncontrollable events disrupt our businesses, reduce demand for or consumption of our products and services, impair our ability to provide our products and services or increase the cost of providing our products and services, adversely impacting our results of operations and financial condition.
We face risks related to changes in our business strategies and plans, which have affected and may continue to affect our cost structure, the value of our assets and/or our results of operations.
